problems.name: Silently-empty drafts are returned unverified: wrong literal casing/value, wrong filter column, or NULL-poisoned NOT IN yield 0 rows with no feedback

attempts.what: solve.py now executes the draft once and, only on SQL error or zero rows, issues a single compact repair call carrying schema-derived evidence (real stored values LIKE-matching each draft literal, foreign-key join pairs when joins exist, NULL count inside a negated subquery)....
